title: hieracium murorum subsp. haegerstroemii
intro: Hieracium murorum subsp. haegerstroemii, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion-like flowering plants known as hawkweeds. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium murorum subsp. haegerstroemii include antioxidant and antispasmodic properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and relieving muscle spasms. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
